tasks.CalculateSum: Compute the sum a + b + c where a and b are the vertical asymptotes, and c is the horizontal asymptote.
tasks.FindHorizontalAsymptote: Determine the horizontal asymptote of the function f(x) = 2x / (x^2 - 5x - 14).
tasks.FindVerticalAsymptotes: Identify the vertical asymptotes of the function f(x) = 2x / (x^2 - 5x - 14).
